playstyle: Stance-based space control with strong movement. Keep the opponent out with long, evasive moves and a good backdash and sidestep, then mix them up from Scarecrow (SCR), Mantis (MNT) and Tarantula (TRT). Wavu warns her moves are slow and committal, easy to whiff punish, and her fast punishes deal little damage.

stances.name: Scarecrow
stances.entry: From moves like 3, ws3 and db+3 (their SCR transition)
stances.note: SCR.2,1 is a Heat Engager; SCR.4 is a tornado power crush; SCR.d+3,3 is +3 on block.

stances.name: Mantis
stances.entry: 2+4 on hit, ws2 and other transitions
stances.note: A grounded stance with its own mix-ups (see the Move Library).

keyMoves: Fast check; 1,3 and 1,4 are her i10 punishes (Wavu).
